name: David Okonkwo
headline: Principal Cloud Engineer
summary: Principal cloud engineer with 16 years in software and infrastructure, from Java development to running regulated Kubernetes platforms on AWS for a major bank.

experience.title: Principal Cloud Engineer
bullets: Lead the nine-person cloud platform team that runs 70 EKS clusters for 1,400 engineers across retail and corporate banking.
Designed the landing-zone Terraform used for 220 AWS accounts, with policy-as-code guardrails signed off by the regulator.
Moved 300 services to GitOps with ArgoCD, cutting mean deployment lead time from 5 days to 3 hours.
Chair the Kubernetes architecture forum and set the bank's container security baseline.

experience.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
bullets: Moved the e-commerce platform from a co-located data centre to AWS with a zero-downtime cut-over before peak season.
Introduced Terraform and Ansible, replacing 40 hand-built servers with reproducible environments.
Built Jenkins pipelines and Docker images for 60 services, taking releases from monthly to daily.

experience.title: Java Developer
bullets: Developed Java back-office modules for a telecoms billing product used by five operators.
Mapped billing entities with Hibernate and tuned the slowest overnight batch queries.
Wrote JUnit regression suites and looked after the team's Linux build servers.
